scale_invariance_analysis.scientific_implication: Under a global multiplicative stopping power scaling factor S in [0.85, 1.15], extracted level lifetimes scale as tau/S and transition strengths B(E2) scale as S*B(E2). However, the inter-band ratio B(E2)_Band2 / B(E2)_Band1 = 0.4902 is strictly scale-invariant. Therefore, the observed 2.06-fold B(E2) difference between 136Nd Band 1 and Band 2 cannot be an artifact of global electronic stopping power miscalibration (such as the 15% SRIM systematic). It reflects either genuine microscopic configuration disparity (e.g. Petrache 2018 TAC-CDFT configurations A vs B) or differential side-feeding time histories between the two cascades.
